propagation_rules: Optional structure failure never erases valid identity, zoning, or standards.
Coastal boundary ambiguity preserves identity and zoning and refuses version-specific standards.
Positive assessor values remain recorded facts; zero and sentinel values remain unknown.
Historical footprints retain date and linkage limitations.
Non-RS zones remain visible and receive no RS rules.
Split zones retain separate zone results and are never blended.

top_state_rules.when: Parcel V2 identity is unavailable; dependent conclusions are not evaluated.
Identity remains available but zoning, Coastal, and structure sources are all unavailable.
A material layer is unavailable/unresolved, mapping is unmapped/ambiguous, Coastal applicability is ambiguous, or standards resolve only partially.
Identity, zoning, Coastal selection and applicable standards are coherent; explicit legal/measurement unknowns remain visible.
